name: AI in the Built Environment and Real Estate: The One-Hour Briefing
description: A free hour built around real jobs in design, construction, real estate and building operations: checking an egress requirement with a code copilot, drafting an RFI and first-checking a submittal, reconciling an AI takeoff, scoring photo hazard tags, writing MLS remarks and disclosing a virtually staged photo, auditing a leasing chatbot, and finding a stuck damper in HVAC trends. Each shows where AI helps, where a licensed or accountable person must decide, and the rule that applies.
fieldOfStudy: AI in the Built Environment and Real Estate

criteria.narrative:
To earn this certificate a learner must: complete all 8 lessons in 3 modules; and pass the final exam: 10 questions, 15 minutes, pass mark 80%, at most 3 attempts, with a 24-hour wait after a failed attempt.

The exam is taken online and is not proctored. The holder's identity is not verified; the name is the one on their account. This is a certificate of completion and assessment issued by Wirewalk Institute of AI. It is not an accreditation, academic credit, license, or a certification from any vendor. Details: https://institute.wirewalk.com/certification/#limits
